_comment: Copy to config.json. Uniswap addresses below are Robinhood Chain mainnet (chain 4663) from Uniswap's official sdk-core (V2_FACTORY_ADDRESSES / V2_ROUTER_ADDRESSES / WETH9); cross-check with `python monitor.py --discover`, which should show the v2 factory emitting pairs and WETH as the top quote token.

quote_tokens._comment: Extra quote-side tokens beyond wrapped native — on Robinhood Chain that's mostly tokenized stocks (long.xyz/Bankr pools). Key = token contract address; addresses below are from Uniswap's official default-token-list (src/tokens/robinhood.json), which has the full stock roster. Set usd to the rough current share price for USD reporting, or leave 0 to report liquidity in share units only. Decimals are read on-chain.
